title: Cotsel event envelope v1
description: Wraps every event Cotsel publishes. The payload is validated against the schema registered for its type and schemaVersion.

eventId.description: Globally unique, stable across retries; consumers deduplicate on it.

schemaVersion.description: Registered payload schema version for this type.

settlementId.description: Trade or settlement identifier when the event concerns one; null otherwise.

orderingKey.description: Events with the same key are applied in occurredAt order.
